description: Display an analysis you wrote after analyze_post, analyze_post_text or understand_social_post handed you the material. Free, and makes no requests — it only draws what you pass it: hook strength, script structure, quotable lines, hashtags, target audience, viral triggers and more, whichever of these you actually produced. Call this after you have done the analysing. Figures are checked against what nooticr returned in this session: its own numbers are drawn, and a row it never returned is drawn marked as unchecked, so there is no need to re-type them exactly.

analysis.description: Your own analysis. Any of: summary, hookStrength (1-10), commentBaitLevel (1-10), scriptStructure {hook,buildUp,payoff,cta}, whyItWorks, suggestedHook, keyQuotes[], suggestedHashtags[], targetAudience, viralTriggers[], negativeSignals[], variationIdeas[], emotionalArc, overlayText(s), niche, callToAction, transcript — every field is optional, and none is required to have used all of them.

post.description: The post object analyze_post/analyze_post_text/understand_social_post handed you, unchanged.

name: show_post_analysis

analysis.description: Your own analysis, any of the fields analyze_post's guidance asked for — summary, hookStrength, scriptStructure, whyItWorks, suggestedHook, keyQuotes, suggestedHashtags, variationIdeas, viralTriggers, targetAudience and more all render if present; every field is optional, and none is required to have used all of them.

cached.description: true when the answer was served from the server's cache, at no cost.

charged.description: false when the call was refused before anything was debited.

commentSample.description: The replies themselves, when they were read. Someone answering "same here, this is exactly my problem" under another person's thread is a better find than the thread — the permalink to quote is still this post's.

commentsRead.description: How many replies were read under this post. 0 means the thread would not open — not that nobody replied. Absent when nothing tried.

externalUrl.description: Permalink — the URL to feed back into another tool.

status.description: verified: every row matched what nooticr returned this session. unverified: some are as re-sent.

unmatched.description: Rows not among what nooticr returned in this session; drawn as sent, unchecked.

title: Show Analysis
